50834321.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to biotinylated BCL6 (unknown origin) by SPR analysis
50834321.references_previous: 16. Cerchietti L, Ghetu AF, Zhu X, et al. A small-molecule inhibitor of BCL6 kills DLBCL in vitro and in vivo. Cancer Cell. 2010;17:400–411. 17. Cardenas MG, Yu W, Beguelin W, et al. Rationally designed BCL6 inhibitors target activated B cell diffuse large B cell lymphoma. J Clin Invest. 2016;126:3351–3362.

original_paragraph.SPR Assay Description (Section 5.2.2): SPR biosensing experiments were performed at 22 °C on a Biacore 4000 instrument equipped with SeriesS CM5 sensor chips (GE Healthcare). HBS-P+(10 mM Heps, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% Surfactant P20, GE Healthcare) supplemented with 1 mM DTT was used as the running buffer for immobilization. NeutrAvidin (Thermo Fisher) was covalently coupled onto the sensor chip following the standard amine coupling procedure according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Typical immobilization levels of NeutrAvidin ranged from 10,000 to 13,000 resonance units (RUs). Subsequently, avi-tagged wt BCL6BTB was injected onto the NeutrAvidin-immobilized sensor chip. The surfaces were blocked by injecting biocytin (Thermo Fisher). Approximately 13,000 RUs of wt BCL6BTB were captured by NeutrAvidin. For the interaction studies, binding experiments were performed in 20 mM Tris, pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.01% Surfactant P20, 1 mM DTT, and 5% DMSO. Sample solutions of different concentrations were injected for 30 or 90 s at a flow rate of 30 μL/min and the dissociation followed thereafter for up to 30 or 240 s. Data processing and analysis were performed using the Biacore 4000 evaluation software (GE Healthcare). Solvent correction was included as described in the Biacore software handbook. Sensorgrams were double-referenced prior to fitting the concentration series to a steady-state affinity model. The dissociation constant Kd was calculated using the equation below. Kd = Rmax × C/R − C where Rmax, R, and C correspond to the sample binding capacity of the surface (RU), the normalized response of the test sample (RU), and the concentration of the test solution (M), respectively.
original_paragraph.Figure 1 Caption: Fig. 1. Known BCL6 inhibitors 79-6 and FX1, and hit compounds 1a and 2a from HTS. aDisplacement of a SMRT-BBD peptide from BCL6BTB corepressor complex was measured by a fluorescence polarization competitive binding assay.16 bDetermined by microscale thermophoresis.17
original_paragraph.Table 1 Footnote: a Inhibition of BCL6-corepressor (BCoR) interaction was measured. b 95% confidence intervals are shown in parentheses.
original_paragraph.Table 1 Data: Compound 1a: ELISA IC50 = 4.5 μM, SPR Kd = 5.0 μM. Compound 2a: ELISA IC50 = 14 μM, SPR Kd = 24 μM.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 20 mM Tris, pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.01% Surfactant P20, 1 mM DTT, and 5% DMSO
